text.p: Losses have forced Thai polyvinyl chloride producer Vinythai Plc to withhold dividend payments for 1996, the company said on Wednesday.

"Due to the company still sustaining retained losses, the board of directors has resolved not to pay dividend from the company's operations for 1996," Vinythai managing director Jean-Pierre Pleska said in a statement filed with the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Vinythai trimmed losses to 220 million baht in the first three quarters of 1996 from 803 million in the same period of 1995.
Vinylthai, in which Belgian group Solvay SA and Thai conglomerate Charoen Pokphand are major shareholders, has not reported its full 1996 earnings.
